en.t: Do not act so high and mighty, shorty.

units.source_text: 阿芳用刷子敲了敲阿雪的腰部，

en.t: Afang tapped Axue on the waist with the brush,

units.source_text: “才八月初，东京人就说是秋天啦秋天啦，

en.t: It is only early August, and people from Tokyo are already saying it is autumn, autumn,

units.source_text: 他们以为山里常年都刮秋风呢。”

en.t: as if they think autumn winds blow in the mountains all year round.
